summary: Packs three color-related bytes from an input object into one DWORD and stores it at the caller-provided output pointer, then returns that output pointer. The packed low byte comes from field this+0x19, the second byte from the second byte of the this pointer value itself (BYTE1(this)), and the high 16 bits from the word at this+0x1A. Used on mesh/vertex color setup paths by sub_44B110 (0x0044B110) and BezierPatchTessellation (0x0044B370).

operations.description: Read the byte at this+0x19 into the low byte of the local accumulator v3.
Read the second byte of the this pointer value (BYTE1(this)) into the second byte of v3.
Read the word at this+0x1A into the high 16 bits of v3.
Write the fully packed DWORD v3 to *a2.
Invoked by sub_44B110 (0x0044B110) and BezierPatchTessellation (0x0044B370) during mesh/vertex color assembly.

unresolved: Second channel is taken from the this pointer value's own second byte (BYTE1(this)), which is unusual for a struct read and may be a decompiler artifact of a mis-typed field access; no packet field evidence references that byte.
